Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION-> -------------------- Lower and upper mantle liner for primary crusher. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS-> -------------------- 1) Material to be used shall be IS-276 Gr-III with minimum% Mn=12.6%, Cr=2.5%,C=1.2% 2) The unmachined casting allowances shall be as per IS-4897. 3)All castings shall be free from casting defects like cracks, blow holes, and sand inclusions etc. 4.The casting has to be heat treated for strength and resistance to wear against Hematitic iron ore. 5.casting shall be stress relieved and the hardness of after treatment should not be less than 229BHN. 6.The bottom and top matching surface of the upper mantle shall be machine finished. 7.The top surface of the lower mantle shall be machine finished. 8.Maximum allowable deviation in thickness of the casting shall not be more than 2mm.

9.Maximum allowable diametral ovality of the unmachined surfaces of the casting shall not be more than 2 mm. 10.Material test certificate shall be submitted by the party from any Govt/NABL approved laboratory. MTC shall be provided along with the supply of the material. 11.Casting shall be free from blow holes, internal cracks and other casting defects and the certificate for th e same shall be provided by the party along with the supply document. 12.Party shall submit their drawings for approval within 2(two) weeks from date of receipt of PO. The inden ter will approve the drawing with in 7 days of receipt of the same from the bidder. Material shall be strictly as per the approved drawings.
